milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The jack_o_lantern is placed at spawn-relative (4, 0, 3) on the ground. It emits light in the dark room making it the first natural target. max_distance=16 allows detection from across the room since it glows visibly. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The potted_dead_bush is at spawn-relative (5, 2, 3) on a stone brick pedestal at eye level. It is near the jack_o_lantern so the player naturally discovers it after finding the lantern. max_distance=16 allows seeing it from a distance since it's elevated. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The blue terracotta corridor entrance is centered at spawn-relative (9, 1, 2) - the front face of the U-shaped corridor. The distinctive blue/purple color contrasts with grey stone bricks. max_distance=16 allows seeing the structure from across the room. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the corridor.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The green stained glass panes are at the back wall of the blue terracotta corridor at spawn-relative (9, 1, 8). The player must navigate into or near the corridor entrance and face the back wall to see them. max_distance=8 is used (smaller than default) because the panes are inside the corridor and require closer approach to actually observe them through the 2-block-wide opening.
